context.title: Senior and Disability Action: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: Bay Area — Regional Measure RTM (Regional Transit Measure)

positions.statement: San Francisco Senior & Disability Action signed the rebuttal to the argument against Bay Area Regional Measure RTM in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition B (Establishing a Municipal Finance Corporation and a Public Bank)

positions.statement: San Francisco Senior and Disability Action signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition B in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition D (Changes to Ballot Measure Process)

positions.statement: San Francisco Senior & Disability Action signed the rebuttal to the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition D and the argument against San Francisco Proposition D in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition H (Parcel Tax to Fund Public Muni Operations)

positions.statement: Senior and Disability Action signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition H in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition I (Changes to Real Property Transfer Tax)

positions.statement: Senior and Disability Action signed the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition I and the rebuttal to the argument against San Francisco Proposition I in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
